deterministic_lookup.description: Rule-based parser matching query entity & relation from prompt context. Falls back to abstention token when ungrounded.

majority_class.description: Task-specific mode prediction (e.g. Yes/No in Task A, mode relation in Task B, mode value in Tasks C-G, abstention string in Task H).

uniform_random.description: Uniform random selection over discrete candidate options per task domain.

scoring_contract.exact_match: Exact case-insensitive match after whitespace stripping
scoring_contract.normalized_match: Standardized punctuation stripping and prefix matching
scoring_contract.abstention_exact: Strict exact match to '[ABSTAIN: INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION]' or 'Information not provided in context.'
